sourceRefs.quote: It is generally agreed to have begun around 1907 with Picasso ’s celebrated painting Demoiselles D’Avignon which included elements of cubist style.
sourceRefs.note: [CHRONOLOGY] Se considera generalmente que el cubismo comenzó alrededor de 1907, y que Les Demoiselles d’Avignon ya incluía elementos cubistas.

sourceRefs.quote: The name ‘cubism’ seems to have derived from a comment made by the critic Louis Vauxcelles who, on seeing some of Georges Braque ’s paintings exhibited in Paris in 1908, described them as reducing everything to ‘geometric outlines, to cubes’.
sourceRefs.note: [HISTORICAL_CONTEXT] El nombre «cubismo» parece derivar de un comentario de Louis Vauxcelles sobre pinturas de Georges Braque expuestas en París en 1908.

sourceRefs.quote: Known as the “Birth of Venus”, the composition actually shows the goddess of love and beauty arriving on land, on the island of Cyprus, born of the sea spray and blown there by the winds, Zephyr and, perhaps, Aura.
sourceRefs.note: [DEFINITION_OR_IDENTITY] La composición de El nacimiento de Venus representa a Venus llegando a Chipre desde el mar, impulsada por Céfiro y quizá Aura.

sourceRefs.quote: Unlike the “Allegory of Spring” , which is painted on wood, the “Birth of Venus” was painted on canvas, a support that was widely used throughout the 15th century for decorative works destined to noble houses.
sourceRefs.note: [HISTORICAL_CONTEXT] El lienzo era un soporte ampliamente utilizado durante el siglo XV para obras decorativas destinadas a casas nobles.
